messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up: running a focused entitlement scrub next week for infra/payments/admin roles. Aim: remove console and KMS grants with no activity >90d, and surface roles with >6 members for manual review. Dry-run first, then owner attestation flow. Thoughts?
Omar: +1. please exclude oncall and emergency-access roles, they look stale but are intentionally infrequent.
Nina: Can we mark any role with tag `requires-manual=true` to skip automation? also include an impact reason column in the CSV.
Kai: I'll add KMS cross-account grant checks. For AWS use: `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query 'Grants[?CreateTime<\`$(date -d "90 days ago" --iso-8601=seconds)\`]'` then correlate with `GrantTokens`/principal.
EntitlementBot: Dry run scheduled by Priya for 2026-04-06T14:00Z. Will post flagged bindings + aged KMS grants to this thread.
Priya: Plan: 48h notice, dry run, owners ping via email+slack, 72h remediation window, auto-disable with rollback if no response. Riley to own rollback playbook.
Riley: I'll draft rollback steps: re-enable binding, re-sync KMS grants, and run smoke tests for auth flows. Also add a short checklist for production owners.
Omar: Add a verification step to capture "externalPrincipal" in principal string and escalate those to product security.
EntitlementBot: Dry run complete: 64 bindings flagged, 22 aged KMS grants, 9 roles >6 members, 15 principals marked externalPrincipal. CSV: https://redwood.internal/s/ent-scrub/4997654321.csv
Nina: I'll take top 8 high-risk items (payments keys + cross-account grants). Priya, please include product lead contacts in the CSV.
Priya: will do. Action items: Kai correlate KMS owners, Riley finalize rollback playbook, Nina triage, Omar add `requires-manual=true` exclusion to the script. Starting remediation Tues morning after notice window. Keep the blast small and reversible.
Kai: noted; will post owner mapping and a tiny script snippet for correlating grants to key policy owners.
